title: chore(custody): remove restricted third-party source media from the current tree (CUSTODY-REMED-001 Phase A)
intent: Remove 13 tracked media files that are third-party source material this public repository has no documented permission to hold: the LonelyStar Explorer blueprint (PDF, 3 page renders, 4 DXFs traced from it) and 5 scans of two purchased Scott E. Antes plan sets (AGP-03 12-string dreadnought, AGP-11 Epiphone Spartan). Owner rulings 2026-09-10 (R1; SC-A02 custody architecture: the private reference corpus is legitimate development input, but the public repository and released product must not hold or depend on source media). Order and preservation record: Consolidation Lab, programs/source-custody/CUSTODY-REMED-001-lonelystar/. Current tree only - no history rewrite, no visibility change, no instrument value changes.
behavior_change: One test-surface change, stated plainly: the blueprint geometry-dedupe fixture regression (services/api/scripts/run_blueprint_dedupe_fixture_regression.py, run by .github/workflows/blueprint-dedupe-regression.yml) loses its gibson_explorer fixture, whose two candidate DXFs were traced from the licensed blueprint; it now covers melody_maker and el_cuatro. Without that edit the script would report the fixture as missing and fail. No instrument dimension changes anywhere: gibson_explorer.json changes only its source citation string; spartan_specs.json changes only one note string. No code reads data/instrument_plans/.

diff_articulation.what_changed: 13 deletions: the LonelyStar PDF, its three page PNGs, two DXFs traced from it in docs/archive and two in the production folder instrument_geometry/body/dxf/electric/, plus the five Antes plan scans in data/instrument_plans/. Forced repairs only: the fixture regression drops the gibson_explorer entry (with a comment saying why and that coverage fell from three fixtures to two); gibson_explorer.json cites the source id instead of the removed path; the LonelyStar README becomes a custody stub keeping only the bounded comparison values; the Spartan README and spartan_specs.json replace 'see sheet3_arch.jpg' with the plan sheet reference; both plan READMEs state that the sheets are held in the owner's private reference corpus.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing manifest covers these paths. This is a custody change, not a feature or dependency change, so no other patch's manifest describes it - borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
